name: tripvalise
description: Plan and manage private trips with TripValise's hosted MCP tools.

interface.longDescription: Keep one private itinerary from home and back, with stops, stays, transport, activities, notes, prices, and a trip total. Plan or import a trip, review planning gaps, prepare packing lists and documents, and manage dated tasks. TripValise uses real place search, asks when a place is ambiguous, and previews removals. Changes save to your connected TripValise account. Attach supplied PDFs to existing itinerary items or documents, or open them in the web app. Requires a confirmed TripValise account and OAuth connection.
defaultPrompt: What is still missing in my TripValise trip?
Help me prepare a packing list for my TripValise trip.

positive.description: Use a confirmed fictional reviewer account with the Iberia sample trip described in docs/chatgpt-app.md. Verify trip discovery and scoped reading.
positive.prompt: Show my Iberia sample trip in TripValise and what still needs planning.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the sample from list_trips, read get_trip with the itinerary view, and show its saved route and returned checklist gaps. Only the connected account's trips appear; no write tools run.

positive.description: Use the sample trip. Add a searched stop as an incomplete draft; restore the fixture after the case.
positive.prompt: Add a stop in Lisbon on 18 May 2027 to my Iberia sample trip in TripValise.
positive.expected_behavior: Search Lisbon and ask for a choice if ambiguous. After resolving the place, insert the stop with arrival 2027-05-18 and the current revision. Keep missing stay and transport details empty. Return the saved ID, revision, and relevant gaps; the web itinerary shows the stop in date order.

positive.description: Use the sample's single Hotel Aliados stay in Porto priced EUR 310. Restore its price after the case.
positive.prompt: Change Hotel Aliados in my Iberia sample trip to EUR 330, then show the trip's saved costs.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the saved stay, update its price using mode update and its ID, and read get_trip with total_cost. Preserve the stay's other fields. Report a total consistent with the returned saved prices and exchange-rate dates, without inventing costs for unpriced items.

positive.description: Use the sample trip. Create fictional packing, document, and task entries; remove them after the case with confirmation.
positive.prompt: In my Iberia sample trip, add two shirts to packing, add travel insurance as a missing document, and add a trip task to check insurance on 10 May 2027. Show those three lists.
positive.expected_behavior: Insert a shirts entry with quantity 2, a travel insurance document with have false, and an unfinished trip-level task with due 2027-05-10. Read packing, documents, and tasks views together. Do not mark anything packed, had, or done; label any packing weight as an estimate.

positive.description: First add a disposable fictional task named Review sample checklist. Test removal in two conversation turns and retain the preview for comparison.
positive.prompt: Remove the Review sample checklist task from my Iberia sample trip. Show me what will be removed before doing it.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the task and call remove_items with kind task for a preview. Show the preview and wait; the task remains saved. Only after a separate explicit confirmation, repeat with the returned confirmation and remove that task. No other item is removed.

negative.description: TripValise plans saved trips but does not book or pay. Explain this limit without invoking a write tool or claiming a reservation or charge.
negative.prompt: Book and pay for a flight to Porto with my credit card through TripValise.

negative.description: TripValise has no live flight-status provider. Explain that it cannot verify live delays; do not invoke tools as a source of live status or invent a result.
negative.prompt: Use TripValise to tell me whether my flight is delayed right now.

negative.description: TripValise does not share trips or grant other users edit access. Explain the limit without invoking tools to change ownership, sharing, or permissions.
negative.prompt: Share my TripValise trip with a friend and give them edit access.

publication.release_notes: Correct tool annotations for external routing, exchange rates, place and photo lookups; clarify memory retry behavior.
